title: Readiness potentials are accumulating motor predictions

statements.text: Readiness potentials in Libet paradigms are evidence accumulation for motor predictions, built up by recurrent activity in frontal and parietal proprioceptive body maps coupled with salience networks. Action is released when a control hub crosses a threshold, an ignition event, which is one way conscious intentions enter the causal stream leading to action.

sources.quote: I suggest RPs—as motor predictions—are biophysically realized via accumulation of recurrent neural activity in frontal-parietal action-oriented proprioceptive body maps
